sourceItems.title: Gold shines as coronavirus surge unnerves investors
normalizedClaims: Gold reached its highest level in nearly eight years as renewed coronavirus concerns increased safe-haven demand, showing a strong monetary/defensive regime but also substantial prior price appreciation.

sourceItems.title: Iron ore volatile as Brazil supply worries ease, but China demand hopes offer support

eventClusters.statement: China commercial-vehicle demand rebounded far faster than passenger vehicles, with May heavy-truck and light-truck sales reaching record levels.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The surge may partly reflect deferred demand, infrastructure stimulus and emissions-policy replacement. Deep research must test duration and company-level profit conversion.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share truck/value-chain expressions had direct volume-to-profit conversion and reasonable expectation burden by late Q2?

eventClusters.statement: Industrial profits turned positive year on year in May, with electronics and special-purpose machinery already showing strong cumulative profit growth despite broad-economy weakness.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Sector aggregates are too broad for direct stock selection. Deep research must identify specific operating variables and avoid equating category strength with every listed company.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are there narrow listed expressions where the observed profit resilience is tied to a measurable company engine rather than broad beta?

eventClusters.statement: Server DRAM remained in a positive pricing cycle, but by late May the expected 2H20 price upside was being revised down as procurement and supply-chain dynamics weakened.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The physical cycle is still positive, so the key test is whether the market already capitalized it and whether the next-period path is weakening.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should memory-related expressions remain actionable, or has the known Q2 strength already become a duration/expectation trap?

eventClusters.statement: Late-Q2 PV upstream prices remained weak, with polysilicon still declining and no confirmed scarcity signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Structural solar demand may still be attractive, but the quarter-end physical pricing signal does not support an upstream scarcity thesis.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should PV remain research-only until demand/pricing inflects, and are any company-specific engines strong enough to override weak upstream pricing?

eventClusters.statement: Gold reached a near eight-year high as pandemic risk and safe-haven demand intensified, creating strong miner cash-flow leverage but also rising expectation-absorption risk.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Deep research must distinguish still-underreflected earnings leverage from simply chasing a commodity already near a multi-year high.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share gold producer still offer acceptable normalized earnings-path room after the Q2 rerating?

eventClusters.statement: China infrastructure/construction demand supported iron ore and steel activity even as broader manufacturing and external demand remained uneven.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Strength may be stimulus-driven and concentrated in construction. Deep research must avoid extrapolating it to all industrial cyclicals.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed expressions, if any, had direct earnings exposure to the infrastructure demand impulse without excessive cycle/valuation risk?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing production and new orders remained in expansion by June, while export orders were still weak.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Use as context and timing evidence only; too broad for direct stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Context only; do not map directly to a stock.
